胡三爷感激的看向王野，两只手握住王野的右手：“小兄弟啊，谢谢你呀，你是不知道呀，彪子是家里唯一的顶梁柱，麻杆儿也是家里的独子，你救的不是他俩，是两个家呀！”

王野都被胡三爷抓的害羞了，赶紧抽出来，摇着手说是碰巧了。就在三爷不停的感谢王野时，从另一个屋里出来了一位妇人怀里还抱着一个婴儿。

胡三彪赶紧上前介绍到：“媳妇儿，这是我们在山里认识的兄弟，他救了我和麻杆儿。”

王野赶紧跟妇人介绍道：“嫂子好，我叫王野。”

接下来就成了胡三爷和胡三彪媳妇儿一起感谢王野，还是胡三彪看出了王野的囧态，上前解围道：“媳妇儿，你去给做点吃的，三爷，您老也陪着王野兄弟喝点儿。”

胡三彪接过孩子，他媳妇儿转身出去了，胡三爷招呼王野上了炕桌。麻杆儿对着胡三彪说：“哥，我回去一下还没跟爹娘说呢。”

胡三彪点点头：“去吧，说一声赶紧回来。”

麻杆儿跟众人打声招呼就出去了，王野多少有点招架不住胡三爷的热情。只能在那里应付着，聊着聊着就聊到了那头熊。

胡三彪：“三爷，您老是村长，又是家里的长辈儿，不说这熊是王野兄弟打的，就说他救了我和麻杆儿的命，我们也不能占他的便宜呀，您说是不是这个理儿？”

胡三爷点点头：“彪子说的在理，我们胡赵两家立足此地两百多年，就没出过这么没良心的的人。”

王野无所谓的说道：“三爷，彪子大哥，我也跟你们说句实话吧，我是从四九城来的，明天就要回去了。这熊皮和熊掌我还能带走，这熊肉熊骨头我是真带不了。”

胡三彪从怀里拿出熊胆：“肉拿不走，这个你得带走吧？这东西可老值钱了！”

王野略显尴尬的说：“彪子大哥，我就是学医的，我能不知道这东西值钱。既然咱哥们儿今天都坐在这里了，我也就没什么好隐瞒了，当时这个熊胆是为了试探大哥的人品的。既然知道了大哥人品没毛病，我是不是也得一口唾沫一个钉。”

“可是～可是～”

王野：“没什么可是的，就当是对彪子大哥试探的歉意了。”

就在三人谈话时，一个只会爬的小不点儿，被他们忽略了。胡三彪的儿子，在炕上正在翻弄王野的背包。包里的东西散落一炕，也就是胡三彪无意间发现了，要不这孩子都要把王野的医书塞进嘴里了。

胡三彪一把抱过玩的正高兴的儿子，拿起医书用袖子轻轻的擦拭着儿子要过的地方，一脸歉意的说道：“王野兄弟，对不住啊，把你的书弄脏了。”

王野接过医书：“彪子大哥，他才多大点儿呀，知道什么呀。”

接过医书装进包里，又从炕上捡起几块糖凑到小不点面前：“看看，这才能吃，书是用来看的，不能吃。”

Hu Sanye looked at Wang Ye gratefully and held Wang Ye's right hand with both hands: "Little brother, thank you, you don't know, Biaozi is the only breadwinner of the family, and Ma Ganer is also the only son of the family. You are not saving them, but two families!"

Wang Ye was so embarrassed by Master Hu that he quickly took it out, waving his hand and saying it was just a coincidence.Just as the third master kept thanking Wang Ye, a woman came out of another room with a baby in her arms.

Hu Sanbiao quickly stepped forward and introduced: "Daughter-in-law, this is the brother we met in the mountains. He saved Ma Gan'er and me."

Wang Ye quickly introduced the woman: "Hello, sister-in-law, my name is Wang Ye."

Next, Hu Sanye and Hu Sanbiao's daughter-in-law thanked Wang Ye together. Hu Sanbiao noticed Wang Ye's embarrassment and stepped forward to rescue him: "Daughter-in-law, go and make some food for me. Third master, you will always have a drink with Wang Ye and his brother."

Hu Sanbiao took the child, and his wife turned around and went out. Hu Sanye called Wang Ye to the Kang table.Ma Gan'er said to Hu Sanbiao: "Brother, I haven't told my parents yet when I get back."

Hu Sanbiao nodded: "Go ahead and tell me to come back quickly."

Ma Gan'er said hello to everyone and went out. Wang Ye was somewhat unable to withstand Mr. Hu's enthusiasm.I could only deal with it there, chatting and talking about the bear.

Hu Sanbiao: "Third Master, you are always the village chief and the elder of the family. You don't say that the bear was shot by Wang Ye's brother. You just say that he saved my life and Ma Gan'er's. We can't take advantage of him. Do you think this is right?"

Mr. Hu nodded: "What Biaozi said makes sense. Our Hu and Zhao families have been here for more than 200 years, and we have never had such a heartless person."

Wang Ye said nonchalantly: "Third Master, Brother Biaozi, let me tell you the truth. I came from Sijiu City and I will go back tomorrow. I can still take away the bear skin and bear paws, but I really can't take away the bear meat and bones."

Hu Sanbiao took out the bear bile from his arms: "You can't take away the meat, so you have to take this with you, right? This thing is very valuable!"

Wang Ye said with a slight embarrassment: "Brother Biaozi, I am a medical student. I don't know how valuable this thing is. Since our brothers are all sitting here today, I have nothing to hide. The purpose of this bear bile was to test my brother's character. Now that I know that there is nothing wrong with my brother's character, I have to spit and nail it."

"But~but~"

Wang Ye: "Nothing to complain about, just think of it as an apology for testing Brother Biaozi."

While the three of them were talking, a little boy who could only crawl was ignored by them.Hu Sanbiao's son was rummaging through Wang Ye's backpack on the kang.The contents of the bag were scattered all over the bed, and Hu Sanbiao discovered it accidentally, otherwise the child would have stuffed Wang Ye's medical book into his mouth.

Hu Sanbiao hugged his son who was playing happily, picked up the medical book and gently wiped the area where his son had passed with his sleeve, and said with an apology: "Brother Wang Ye, I'm sorry, I soiled your book."

Wang Ye took the medical book: "Brother Biaozi, how old is he? What does he know?"

He took the medical book and put it in his bag, then picked up a few pieces of candy from the bed and put it in front of the little one: "Look, only this can be eaten. The book is for reading, not eating."
